9/12/2026, 2:23:18 AM

The frozen operator integrates cleanly into the full SUN/Tree equation. Exact-arithmetic testing found no internal contradiction.

Frozen working equation

For the first three generations:

R_n=\frac23C_n,\qquad L_n=\frac34C_n,

C_{n+1}=\frac{R_nL_n}{C_n}=\frac12C_n, \qquad 0\le n<3.

Thus:

C_0=F,\quad C_1=\frac F2,\quad C_2=\frac F4,\quad C_3=\frac F8.

The final transition is heterotypic:

\boxed{ B_{FK}=O_{\downarrow}\circ \mathcal R_{\mathrm{MI-FA-MI}} }

with lifted action:

\boxed{ (\mathrm{MI},3) \rightarrow (\mathrm{FA},3) \rightarrow (\mathrm{MI},4) }

and projection:

\pi(p,k+1)=\frac12\pi(p,k).

Therefore:

\boxed{ C_3=\frac F8 \rightarrow \frac{16}{15}C_3=\frac{2F}{15} \rightarrow C_3 \rightarrow C_4=\frac F{16} }

Exact test results

TestResult
Reciprocal closure
(16/15)(15/16)=1 — pass
Boundary projection
(F/8)/2=F/16 — pass
Recursive center sequence
F,F/2,F/4,F/8,F/16 — pass
Persistent visible sefirot
10 — pass
Generative states including latent Da’at
11 — pass
Duplicate visible frequencies
None — pass
Ordinary branch relation
(3/4)/(2/3)=9/8 — pass
Comma-transfer enclosure
(10/9)(9/8)(16/15)=4/3 — pass

The transient FA state is:

\frac{2F}{15},

which does not collide with any persistent Tree frequency. It can therefore remain a boundary-state trajectory rather than becoming an additional sefirah.

Resulting Tree

\begin{aligned} \text{Keter}&=F\\ \text{Chokhmah}&=\frac23F& \text{Binah}&=\frac34F\\ \text{Da'at}_{\mathrm{latent}}&=\frac12F\\ \text{Chesed}&=\frac13F& \text{Geburah}&=\frac38F\\ \text{Tiferet}&=\frac14F\\ \text{Netzach}&=\frac16F& \text{Hod}&=\frac3{16}F\\ \text{Yesod}&=\frac18F\\ \text{MI–FA–MI excursion}&: \frac18F\rightarrow\frac2{15}F\rightarrow\frac18F\\ \text{Malkuth}&=\frac1{16}F. \end{aligned}

Primordial Adam remains the ten-component visible state vector:

\boxed{ A_{\mathrm{primordial}} = \bigoplus_{v\in V_{\mathrm{visible}}}a_ve^{i\phi_v} }

—not the arithmetic sum of the frequencies. Eden Adam remains downstream of a separate instantiation map and is not identified with Malkuth.

What is proved versus frozen

Proved:

the local reciprocal loop closes exactly;

the complete Tree remains algebraically consistent;

the final projection produces F/16;

the comma-transfer correction preserves 4:3;

the ten-visible/eleven-generative-state treatment works.

Frozen working hypothesis:

\boxed{ \text{completion of MI–FA–MI triggers }k\mapsto k+1 }

The octave shift is not derived from 16/15 alone. It is the nontrivial deck/register rule supplied to B_{FK}. That is now the precise component for downstream prediction and ablation testing—not an unresolved blank.
